column1: # Unified cross-frontend interaction matrix (S4).  Committed declaration data only.
# The three per-frontend matrices in scripts/ remain as compatibility views until S5
# retires them; this file is the single unified list (one row per (frontend, case_id)).
#   case_id            stable case id from the owning frontend's matrix
#                      `-` where no requirement mapping is declared yet (Bevy rows)
#   test_name          nextest test path; `-` when the frontend declares the stable
#   paths              ordered behavior/contract paths (matrix semantics preserved)
#   contract_tag       first `paths` token (the row's primary contract tag); the
#                      resolver checks this equality.  The vocabulary authority is the
#                      Rust ContractTag enum; never copy the tag set into TSV/Python/bash.
#                      Bevy path tokens are folded into that enum (D5); the enum's
#                      conformance test validates this file's tag and path columns.
#   platform           RESERVED P5 axis; empty = frontend axis, opaque here.
# Anchors are declared by hand (transcribed from the per-frontend matrices on
# 2026-09-22) and verified by set membership against `cargo nextest list`; test ids
# are never derived by scanning Rust source.
